about.title: About SamvadUrja & Dr. Shivie Gupta
about.p1: With approximately 35 years of dedicated counselling experience, Dr. Shivie Gupta has walked alongside hundreds of individuals, couples, and families navigating emotional turmoil, relational strain, life transitions, and self-doubt.
about.p2: Her therapeutic philosophy is anchored in deep, patient active listening and confidential guidance. Recognizing that facing a therapist in a formal clinic or over high-stress video calls can heighten vulnerability and self-consciousness, Dr. Gupta conducts all counselling sessions exclusively via telephone/voice call—allowing clients to speak from their personal sanctuary in total safety and comfort, in either Hindi or English.
about.p3: As a secondary wellness complement, Dr. Gupta also offers traditional Usui Reiki biofield balancing strictly upon request for clients who wish to cultivate somatic calm and relaxation alongside their emotional journey.
about.pillar1Desc: Zero webcams, camera anxiety, or clinic waiting rooms. Complete confidentiality over telephone or WhatsApp audio call from anywhere in India.
about.pillar2Desc: Mature, compassionate perspective built over decades of listening to real people, understanding cultural complexities, and restoring household peace.
about.pillar3Desc: For clients interested in holistic energy relaxation, traditional Usui Reiki is available on request to support physical ease alongside counselling.
about.boundaryP1: Dr. Shivie Gupta’s voice counselling is an emotional support, relationship mediation, and personal clarity practice. It is not an emergency crisis intervention line, psychiatric diagnostic clinic, or hospital psychiatric facility.
about.boundaryP2Before: If you or a loved one is experiencing severe clinical distress, self-harm thoughts, or acute psychiatric crises, please immediately reach out to professional emergency resources such as the Tele-MANAS helpline (

faqs.question: Why speak directly with a senior practitioner (~35 years experience) instead of a therapy app?
faqs.answer: Unlike marketplace aggregator apps that rotate callers across junior associates or algorithmic matching queues, you speak directly with Dr. Shivie Gupta on every single session. With ~35 years of clinical wisdom, Dr. Gupta provides steady, nuanced emotional guidance for complex family dynamics, marital crossroads, and anxiety—at transparent, predictable per-session fees (₹1,200 to ₹2,200) without forced multi-session packages or subscription locks.

faqs.question: How does a voice-only call work if I live in a joint family or shared home with limited privacy?
faqs.answer: In many Indian households, privacy is hard to find and locking a bedroom door can draw unwanted questions. Because sessions are conducted strictly over standard telephone or WhatsApp audio call, there is zero need for a laptop, video camera, or conspicuous app notifications. You can comfortably take your session from a quiet balcony, terrace, private corner, or parked car—allowing you to speak freely without family or in-laws overhearing.

faqs.question: How can I talk about household atmosphere or in-law pressure over a voice call?
faqs.answer: You can speak freely and comfortably in Hindi or English. Sensitive topics such as household tension, in-law expectations, family remarks, or interpersonal friction can be shared openly with Dr. Shivie Gupta without fear of judgment. No formal preparation is needed—just a quiet corner and your own voice.

faqs.question: Is Reiki mandatory during counselling, or is it purely optional?
faqs.answer: Reiki is 100% optional and offered strictly upon client request as a secondary wellness complement (₹1,000 / 45 mins). Voice-only counselling for individuals, couples, and families is Dr. Shivie Gupta's core primary practice. Traditional Usui Reiki is available exclusively for clients who specifically desire calm somatic relaxation, nervous system down-regulation, or meditative stillness alongside or apart from talk sessions.

faqs.question: Why are all counselling sessions conducted exclusively over voice/phone call?
faqs.answer: Over ~35 years of practice, Dr. Shivie Gupta has found voice-only phone calls to offer the highest emotional safety, complete privacy, and zero video camera self-consciousness. Clients speak with genuine vulnerability from their personal sanctuary without traveling, clinic waiting rooms, or technical video fatigue.

faqs.question: Do I need to turn on my camera or install special video software?
faqs.answer: No. All consultations take place via standard telephone voice call or WhatsApp audio call. You do not need any special software, webcam, or video setup—just a quiet, comfortable space where you can speak freely.

faqs.question: What is the background and experience of Dr. Shivie Gupta?
faqs.answer: Dr. Shivie Gupta brings approximately 35 years of dedicated experience in emotional counselling, relationship guidance, and family harmony. Her practice is grounded in empathetic active listening, practical cognitive tools, and gentle biofield awareness in Dayalbagh, Agra.

faqs.question: What are the session charges and how do I schedule an appointment?
faqs.answer: Sessions range from ₹1,000 to ₹2,200 depending on whether it is an Individual, Couple, Family, or Reiki session. You can request a session using the online inquiry form or connect directly via call or WhatsApp at +91 9837891692.

faqs.question: Is Reiki compulsory or is it a separate offering?
faqs.answer: Reiki is completely optional and secondary. Dr. Shivie Gupta's primary practice is voice-only counselling. Traditional Usui Reiki is available exclusively for clients who specifically express interest in subtle energy balancing and deep relaxation.

faqs.question: Is counselling suitable for emergency mental health crises?
faqs.answer: No. Voice counselling with Dr. Shivie Gupta is an emotional support and personal guidance practice. It is not an emergency crisis intervention hotline or psychiatric emergency service. Individuals experiencing severe acute distress or crisis should contact national helplines (such as Tele-MANAS at 14416 in India) or visit a local hospital immediately.

faqs.question: Is voice-only phone counselling just as effective as in-person sessions?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely. Speaking over a phone call lets you open up from the peace of your home without hesitation, camera anxiety, or clinic travel. With ~35 years of experience, Dr. Shivie Gupta listens with full attention and complete confidentiality.

faqs.question: How do I book or schedule a session?
faqs.answer: You can submit your name, phone number, and preferred time through the 'Request Session' form on this website, or call/WhatsApp directly at +91 9837891692 to schedule your session.

faqs.question: Can voice counselling help with relationship and family tension?
faqs.answer: Yes. In Couple and Family counselling, both sides are heard calmly and practical ways are worked out to resolve anger, communication gaps, and mutual misunderstandings.
